scope: Review 15 existing entries using current first-party product pages, documentation, pricing and status information. No tools were added to increase the catalog count.

accepted.name: Artbreeder
accepted.description: AI image creation and editing workspace with prompt-based generation, Composer, Mixer, collage tools and Animator for turning still images into short videos.
accepted.userValue: A current image-creation and editing workspace with prompt generation, remixing, Composer/Mixer workflows and Animator; its updates page documents active model and feature updates.

accepted.name: Augment Code
accepted.description: Agentic software-development platform with codebase-aware agents and Cosmos workflows for planning, implementation, code review, testing, incident response and large-scale migrations.
accepted.userValue: An agentic software-development platform for context-aware planning, coding, review, testing and maintenance workflows across larger codebases.

accepted.name: Auphonic
accepted.description: Automatic audio post-production for podcasts and spoken-word media: loudness normalization, noise and reverb reduction, filtering, speech recognition, chaptering, multitrack processing and publishing/API integrations.
accepted.userValue: A production audio post-processing service with automatic loudness, noise and reverb processing, speech recognition, multitrack and publishing workflows; the service documents a monthly free allowance.

accepted.name: AutoGPT
accepted.description: Agent platform for building, running and managing multi-step AI agents with integrations, workflows and hosted or self-hosted deployment; the classic open-source agent remains a separate project component.
accepted.userValue: A current agent platform with hosted and self-hosted deployment. Its repository distinguishes the MIT-licensed classic components from the Polyform Shield platform, so it is not labeled simply open source.

accepted.name: AUTOMATIC1111 Stable Diffusion WebUI
accepted.description: Local browser-based interface for Stable Diffusion with text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting, outpainting, extensions, scripts and fine-grained generation controls.
accepted.userValue: A maintained local Stable Diffusion interface with detailed generation, inpainting, extensions and scripts; recent repository activity confirms it remains a usable project despite infrequent tagged releases.

accepted.name: B12
accepted.description: AI website builder and business platform for professional services, combining site generation and editing with client intake, scheduling, CRM, email marketing, contracts, payments and hosting.
accepted.userValue: A current AI website and business platform with a free entry plan and paid features for professional-service businesses.

accepted.name: Base44
accepted.description: AI app builder that turns natural-language specifications into full-stack applications with database, authentication, storage, integrations, payments, hosting and deployment.
accepted.userValue: A current natural-language full-stack app builder with a free entry plan and paid usage tiers.

accepted.name: BentoML
accepted.description: Open-source Python framework for packaging and serving AI/ML models as production inference APIs, alongside the Bento Inference Platform for managed and self-hosted deployments.
accepted.userValue: An active open-source model-serving framework plus a commercial inference platform for production deployment.

accepted.name: Bito
accepted.description: Developer platform combining a codebase context engine, AI Architect knowledge graph, autonomous development agents, model routing and AI code review integrated with Git providers and editors.
accepted.userValue: A current developer platform for codebase context, AI-assisted code review and agentic engineering workflows; the current pricing page presents trial and paid plans.

accepted.name: Boomy
accepted.description: AI music creation platform for generating and personalizing original songs, with distribution and commercial-use options tied to paid Creator and Pro memberships.
accepted.userValue: An active AI music creation platform. Its official licensing help distinguishes free creation from paid Creator/Pro commercial-download rights.

accepted.name: Botpress
accepted.description: AI agent platform with visual Studio, TypeScript ADK, knowledge bases, web search, integrations, webchat and human-support handoff through Desk.
accepted.userValue: A current visual and developer platform for building AI agents with knowledge, integrations, webchat and human handoff; official pricing documents a free tier and paid plans.

accepted.name: Braintrust
accepted.description: AI application observability and evaluation platform for tracing model and agent behavior, scoring outputs, running datasets and experiments, and analyzing production traces.
accepted.userValue: An active evaluation and observability platform for tracing, testing and improving AI applications, with an official free Starter plan and paid tiers.

accepted.name: Brisk Teaching
accepted.description: AI teaching platform that helps educators create lesson materials, adapt instruction, give feedback and generate student-facing activities inside Google and Microsoft education workflows.
accepted.userValue: An active AI teaching product with educator tools and a free teacher plan plus paid school/district plans.

rejected.name: AskCodi
rejected.reason: Current official positioning is a done-for-you AI software agency rather than a self-serve AI tool. Remove from the active tools catalog.

rejected.name: Beatoven.ai
rejected.reason: Temporarily remove pending official-domain integrity verification: current accessible homepage and product subpages contain unrelated promotional and placeholder content, so the directory cannot confidently direct users to this destination.
rejected.recheckCondition: Reconsider only after the official domain and product destination are verified clean and consistently represent Beatoven's music product.

corrections.name: AutoGPT
corrections.reason: The platform license is Polyform Shield while classic components are MIT; avoid a blanket Open source label.

corrections.name: Auphonic
corrections.reason: Official pricing documents the monthly free processing allowance.

corrections.name: Augment Code
corrections.reason: Current pricing lists paid plans; do not carry forward the old generic free-tier label.

corrections.name: B12
corrections.reason: Current official pricing includes a free entry plan.

corrections.name: BentoML
corrections.reason: Distinguish the open-source serving framework from the commercial inference platform.

corrections.name: Bito
corrections.reason: Current pricing is presented as trial and paid plans.

corrections.name: Boomy
corrections.reason: Official licensing ties commercial-download rights to Creator and Pro memberships.

notes: AskCodi was removed because its current official positioning is an AI software agency, not a self-serve AI tool.
Beatoven.ai was removed pending domain-integrity verification, not because the music-generation concept itself lacks value.
AUTOMATIC1111 remains accepted because the official repository shows recent maintenance activity even though tagged releases are infrequent.
AutoGPT is not labeled simply Open source because the platform and classic components use different licenses.
No popularity, traffic, revenue, customer-count or ranking claims were used as acceptance evidence.
